keywords: EVM 上后量子验签的三种执行方式
三个 EIP 被标记 stagnant
summary: 周日。Magicians 讨论指出，EVM 上的后量子验签被混为一谈：原生合约验证、ZK 证明与协议层强制是不同路线，混用会让 gas 对比失真。nxt3d 提交两份 Agent 注册表 ERC，mudgen 提交 Facet-Based Diamonds。

items.topic: 交易签名：后量子验签的路线
items.title: Magicians：EVM 上的后量子，别把原生、ZK 与协议强制混在一起
items.note: （pipavlo82）06:54：讨论 Falcon、Dilithium、ML-DSA 的 gas 时，若不先区分合约内原生验证、ZK 证明验证与协议层强制，比较在结构上就有误导。
items.title_en: Magicians: PQ on EVM, stop mixing native, ZK and protocol enforcement
items.note_en: (pipavlo82), 06:54: gas comparisons of Falcon, Dilithium and ML-DSA are structurally misleading unless native in contract verification, ZK proof verification and protocol enforcement are separated first.

keywords_en: Three enforcement lanes for post-quantum verification on the EVM
a historical ownership extension for ERC-721
six years of the rollup roadmap
summary_en: Sunday. A Magicians post argued that post-quantum verification on the EVM conflates native contract verification, ZK proofs and protocol enforcement, which makes gas comparisons misleading. nxt3d submitted two agent registry ERCs and mudgen submitted Facet-Based Diamonds.
